change: Detected JPEG retains the existing Thumbnailator EXIF orientation decoder. Other detected formats decode with seekForwardOnly=true and ignoreMetadata=true. Byte/pixel limits and nonblocking two-slot admission are preserved. No dependency/codec/base/policy change.

dependencyContext.scope: Observed local locked dependency source/bytecode distinction for normal portrait input. No reproduction or attack fixture was created or executed.

observedDependencyCalls.observation: A new registered ImageReader is selected and initialized through one-argument setInput(Object); the true,true application precheck settings are not propagated. Local JAR javap confirms this invocation and its line number.

When EXIF orientation is enabled, getExifOrientation(reader,0) is attempted before format-name/dimension reads and full pixel decode. The call has no JPEG-format guard; caught exceptions allow orientation fallback or continuation.

getImageMetadata(imageIndex) runs before requesting the JPEG-specific metadata tree. JPEG-specific orientation extraction therefore does not prevent the initial metadata request for a PNG reader. Local JAR bytecode confirms the order.
The raw-stream fallback stops intercepting when JPEG SOI is absent; this does not guard the earlier ImageReader metadata request.

jdkApiContract.observation: One-argument setInput(input) is equivalent to setInput(input,false,false). The true ignoreMetadata flag in the separate precheck permits metadata to be ignored; it is not a universal provider parsing prohibition.

dependencyContext.conclusion: The normal portrait dependency path allows and explicitly requests image metadata even though the separate dimension precheck permits ignoring it. A PNG reader can receive getImageMetadata(0) before the JPEG-tree attempt; exact provider behavior was not executed or measured.

proposedReproduction.status: AGENT_CYBERSECURITY_FILTER_BLOCKED_BEFORE_START; replaced by ordinary-size defensive contract validation
proposedReproduction.observation: An earlier proposed compressed-PNG bounded local test was superseded by source-only documentation and a separately owned normal-size source fix. No exploit result is claimed.

regressionScope: Ordinary PNG reader contract rejects the exact previous decoder expression, while new normalization performs an ignored-metadata pixel read without a metadata request; registered provider restored in finally.
Ordinary PNG optional text has byte-identical normalized output; claimed JPEG MIME cannot choose the EXIF path.
All eight JPEG EXIF orientation outputs retained, even with claimed PNG MIME.
Opaque input retains the read-error response.
